summary: Traffic-engineering link attributes were first used with RSVP-TE, but newer applications like Segment Routing Policy and Loop-Free Alternates also use them. The existing advertisements can't carry application-specific values or show which applications use them. This document defines OSPF advertisements that can. It obsoletes RFC 8920.

eli5.summary: One road sign used to serve every vehicle type. This lets the sign show separate notes for bikes and trucks, and say who each note is for.
